subtasks.title: Bound buildZoneSummaries() spatial join (MATERIALIZED CTE) + relabel terminal-failure skip reason
subtasks.approach:
Two coupled changes in the end-of-shift summary path, both TDD (red before green):

(1) QUERY FIX — app/Services/Scout/BuildShiftSummary.php::buildZoneSummaries() (currently 178-193). Rewrite the raw SQL so Postgres computes the shift's small candidate scan set BEFORE the spatial predicate: wrap the scans pre-filter in a MATERIALIZED CTE, then join THAT to platform.zones. Keep the read on DB::connection('platform') (NO zod re-route). Preserve output columns, ORDER BY, and the fact it counts ALL scans incl hidden (raw SQL intentionally bypasses ShowVisibleScan — do NOT add an is_visible filter). Reorder the bindings to match the new placeholder order (CTE: kit_id, start, end; outer: org_id). A bbox (z.geom && s.geo) pre-filter ahead of ST_Contains is optional belt-and-suspenders (redundant with the GiST index but harmless) — implementer's discretion.

(2) AC-3 RELABEL — app/Jobs/Scout/SendEndOfShiftSummary.php::failed() (125-142). Record a build/query-timeout-specific summary_skipped_reason distinct from the mail-send case: when the terminal exception is a DB/query failure (the observed 57014, an Illuminate\Database\QueryException) record 'build_failed'; otherwise keep 'mail_failed' for a genuine mail-send failure. Keep the existing Log::error (Nightwatch ingests it). No new alert channel. summary_skipped_reason is varchar(64) with no check constraint → no migration.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
BuildShiftSummary.php: replace the buildZoneSummaries() DB::connection('platform')->select(...) SQL+bindings with:
  WITH shift_scans AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, scanned_at, geo FROM public.scans
    WHERE kit_id = ? AND scanned_at >= ? AND scanned_at <= ?
  )
  SELECT s.id AS scan_id, s.scanned_at AS scanned_at,
         z.id AS zone_id, z.name AS zone_name, z.color AS zone_color
  FROM shift_scans s
  JOIN platform.zones z ON public.ST_Contains(z.geom, s.geo)
  WHERE z.org_id = ? AND z.deleted_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY s.scanned_at, z.id
  -- bindings: [kit_id, startedAt, endedAt, org_id]
(loadZonePolygonsForMap stays unchanged.)
SendEndOfShiftSummary.php::failed(): compute $reason = $exception instanceof QueryException ? 'build_failed' : 'mail_failed'; forceFill(['summary_skipped_reason' => $reason]). Add the QueryException import.

tests_plan.what_it_pins: New test closing the documented cross-connection gap: seed public.scans directly via DB::connection('platform')->table('scans')->insert(...) inside the shift window/kit (some inside a zone, some outside), create a Zone and call rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() so z.geom is populated; assert forShift()'s zone breakdown (scans/hits/timeInZoneMinutes) is unchanged/correct after the rewrite, AND (DB::connection('platform')->enableQueryLog(), DEV-2309 style) that the emitted SQL now contains the CTE fence (str_contains 'shift_scans' and 'materialized'). Freeze time near the fixture (Carbon setTestNow) per the CH hot-table TTL / forWindow recency gotchas.

Add a case: a terminal QueryException (simulating the 57014, e.g. a BuildShiftSummary mock/binding that throws QueryException) → failed() records summary_skipped_reason='build_failed'. Keep/adjust the existing terminal_failure_records_mail_failed_skip_reason so a genuine mail-send failure still records 'mail_failed'.

perf_gate: N/A — the large table (public.scans) is Postgres, not a >1B-row ClickHouse surface, so the WS6 CH-at-scale perf gate does not apply. AC-1's effectiveness at prod scale is (per the AC's own wording) verified via post-deploy laravel.log; the MATERIALIZED CTE bounds cost by first principles (partition pruning + (kit_id,scanned_at) btree → tiny scan set before the spatial join).
sizing: 4 files, one cohesive bugfix (2 ACs: bound the query + make the terminal failure legible). Within one ticket; no split.
